capabilities: Draw sketches with pen, brush, highlighter, and object or pixel erasers
Save sketches as re-editable .sketch files that autosave
Embed live inline sketch previews in notes
Export sketches as PNG or SVG
Select, transform, and shape-snap strokes with lasso and hold-to-snap gestures
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README flags it as an 'actively evolving MVP' with a roadmap listing a text tool, image support, and layers as upcoming.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw sketches by hand and keep them as editable files inside the vault.
summary: Sketching plugin that lets you draw freehand in the vault, save re-editable .sketch files, embed live sketches in notes, and export PNG or SVG.
